clips.title: The story
paras: 'Lost in the Shadows' is a quest involving the rescue of Pal'juh, an impetuous hunter who ventured into danger alone. Her rescue highlights the delicate balance between raw aggression and patient stalking required of wilderness trackers.

'Lost in the Shadows' involves locating and rescuing Pal'juh, a talented but hotheaded hunter who ventured out alone into hostile territory. Unwilling to wait for support, she found herself in over her head, requiring outside assistance to ensure her safe return.

Upon Pal'juh's rescue, her overseers note that while her potential as a scout and tracker is undeniable, she charges headlong like a raptor rather than stalking with the patience of a tiger. Surviving the ordeal serves as a stark reminder of the wilderness's unforgiving nature.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ich bin alleine losgezogen, um die Klippe etwas auszukundschaften. Leider ist mir gerade im falschen Moment die Magie ausgegangen und nun stecke ich hier fest.
Wenn Ihr mir zur Flucht verhelfen könntet, wäre ich Euch überaus dankbar.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, Pal'juh got herself in trouble again, did she?
Hopefully she learns her lesson about going alone this time. Thank you for helping her. She's a promising hunter, just tends to act more like a raptor than a tiger.
